notes.title: Post Update Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with text
[*] Added new racing tracks and also added zombie mode tracks
[*] Further UI improvements
[/list]

notes.title: UI Rework
notes.content:
Update includes:

[list]
[*] Reworked Main Menu UI for easier access to tracks and less clicks to start playing
[*] Populated featured selection tracks for Race, Drift and Tricks categories with fine tuned tracks for most fun gameplay
[*] Refined Magnum muscle car parameters to be more predictable making it a viable contender for certain tracks
[*] Fixed some bugs with different tracks
[*] Track of Day/Week/Month/Year now visible in the Main Menu
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394103/7504c3c86c4380d639ea24cf26e5aa801983af79.png[/img]

notes.title: Isle of Man track fix
notes.content: Fixed issue for Isle of Man track where asphalt acted like dirt in terms of traction.

notes.title: Patch notes for March 3, 2025
notes.content: Fixed issue where drift points would not be added after restarting the race.

notes.title: Small bug patch fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed 50 laps by default bug
[*] Fixed 10 songs playing at once when the server is full with 10 people
[*] Fixed "No-Kick-Button" bug, where there wasn't actually a button to kick a player from server
[*] UI adjustments to make it easier to understand what's happening (top of the screen now clearly states what mode the server is running on)
[/list]
